value.visualThesis: A friendly-premium SEO agency system: full-bleed dark-violet photographic hero at the top, then a long light-gray SaaS body where surface shifts sequence the page (dark hero → light about split with masked portrait → light logo strip → very tall asymmetric service-card collection → two narrative splits with floating chips → violet-pill accordion FAQ → photo-backed card band → compact newsletter form → black contact banner and dense dark footer). Violet is a deliberately low-frequency accent confined to pill CTAs, badges, icon chips and accordion pills; all attention is steered to actions. Three-family typography (rounded-geometric display, tracked bold section headings, legible UI body) with capitalize heading voice. Identity is carried by pill-shaped violet buttons with trailing icons, the masked portrait blob, asymmetric card rows of 4/2/4, floating chips, and dark anchor surfaces framing light content.

signatureTraits.description: Full-bleed ~964px (~1.07 viewport) hero with a photographic background (candid collaborative office scene) under a dark violet wash; 60px display headline and violet pill CTA overlaid with text-safe darkened zones.

Header bar (~143px desktop) with a centered inline navigation strip of 15px/600 capitalize links and a distinct violet pill CTA at the right; collapses to a compact mobile menu keeping the pill CTA reachable.
Near-full-height (~870px) light editorial split: large portrait-orientation photo inside a soft lavender circular/blob mask on the left, dense multi-bullet copy on the right.

The tallest region (~1670px, ~1.86 viewports): asymmetric card collection of 6 services — 4-across icon-card row, then 2-across wide cards, then remaining row — equal white rounded cards with small violet pill 'Learn more' actions and square icon chips.

Two sequential narrative splits (~700px and ~870px) pairing medium photo subjects with copy and small floating chips; one image right-aligned, one left-aligned. Chips carry qualitative/stage labels (e.g., process numbers 01–04), never invented metrics.

~760px light FAQ band: small flat illustration/subject montage on the left, right-stacked violet pill-shaped accordion rows with chevrons; first item expanded in dark text, remaining rows as saturated violet pills.

Photo-backed card band (~430–480px): full-bleed real workplace photograph darkened, with white rounded cards and one dark accent card overlaying the left half. Content adapted to RankForge: service/positioning cards and stage chips instead of invented client testimonials.

Systemic rounded-pill violet buttons with small trailing arrow/plus glyphs used for every CTA and per-card action; small uppercase pill badges precede section headings; violets rgb(142,45,226) and rgb(78,47,218) family anchor the accent.

fidelityPriorities: 1. Region/surface sequence — dark hero, light body, lavender tints, photo mass, dark contact/footer; this alternation does most of the page's sequencing work.
2. Hero composition — full-bleed darkened photo with overlaid display headline and violet pill CTA.
3. Violet pill button/badge system — CTA shapes, fills and trailing icons across the entire page.
4. Very tall asymmetric services collection (~1.86 viewports) with 4/2 row rhythm, icon chips and per-card pill CTAs.
5. Typography relationships — three-family stack with 60px display vs 40px H2 vs 16px body contrast and capitalize heading voice.
6. Masked portrait blob in the about split and floating chips in narrative splits.
7. Photo-backed card band and black contact banner + dense dark footer as closing anchors.
8. Responsive identity — single-column stacking that preserves overlays, masks, pill system and all sections without content removal.

globalGrid.containerLogic: Full-bleed section surfaces (washes, photo bands, dark banners) span 100vw; inner content constrained to a centered ~1200px container on a 1440px page. Header is full-width with its own inner container. Splits use a two-column grid (image column ~40–45%, copy column ~55–60%). Card collection uses 4-column grid for narrow cards and 2-column grid for wide cards within the same container.

value.spacingRhythm: Generous, even section padding (~96–112px desktop, halving on mobile) with the services collection internally denser (~48–64px between card rows). Editorial rhythm comes from surface changes and tall regions rather than irregular padding; badges sit ~16px above headings, headings ~24px above copy, cards ~24–32px gaps. Compact exceptions: the newsletter band (~340px) and the trusted-logos strip are deliberately tighter than main content regions.

typographyRoles.description: Figtree 700, 60px/78px desktop (~clamp 34px–60px), capitalize; white on the darkened hero photo; max ~2–3 lines.
Montserrat 700, 40px/48px, 0.8px letter-spacing, capitalize; preceded by a small violet pill badge label; used for every major section title.
Figtree 700, 40px/40px desktop scaling to ~24px in cards, 0.8px tracking; creates compressed hierarchy below H2 inside splits and card titles.
Poppins 400, 16px/22.4px, neutral gray #374151 on light surfaces, light gray on dark; measure ~60–75 characters.
Poppins 600, 15px, capitalize; used for header links, pill CTA labels, badges and footer utility links.
Small violet-tinted pill, Poppins 600 ~13–14px capitalize; sits directly above each H2.
Compact floating chip text, Poppins 600 ~13–15px; used for process stage numbers/labels in narrative splits.

colorRoles.description: #8E2DE2 as the reference's saturated violet accent: CTA fills, badges, FAQ pills, icon chips. Low-to-mid frequency; never floods surfaces. Exact value stays the brand anchor.
#4E2FDA for hover states, dark accent cards, gradient depth in the hero wash and selected icon chips.
Dark violet overlay family (rgb(48,32,64) to rgb(96,64,112)) over the hero photograph, guaranteeing white text contrast.
Light neutral #F0F0F0-family and body #F9FAFB dominate ~65–70% of the page; occasional faint lavender tints #F0E0FF on specific bands.
Near-black #101010 for the contact banner, #505050-family for footer content bands; frame the page top (hero) and bottom (footer).
#374151 body on light; near-white on dark/violet surfaces; high-contrast dark text on white cards.
Subtle 1px light borders on cards and inputs; minimal border usage elsewhere — surfaces and pills carry the structure.

value.surfaceLanguage: Systemic: equal white rounded cards (radius ~16px) with subtle shadows; violet pill fills (radius 999px) with small trailing icons; faint lavender-tinted light bands alternating with plain light gray. Signature: soft lavender circular/blob mask around the about portrait; full-bleed photographic masses under violet or dark overlays; near-black banner strip. Minimal borders; no glassmorphism, no gradients beyond the hero wash, no heavy shadows. Flat illustration chips (~90px squares) appear beside the FAQ and in service icon positions.
value.headerNavigation: Desktop header ~143px: logo left, centered inline nav strip (~568px, Poppins 15px/600 capitalize links) with a violet pill CTA ('Request an SEO Consultation') at the right. No transparency/overlap over the hero — the header sits as its own bar above the dark hero. No measured sticky behavior: use a simple static header (or conservative sticky with solid background) rather than inventing scroll-state effects. Mobile: header compresses, nav collapses into a compact menu button, pill CTA remains visible/reachable.

homepageFirstViewport.summary: First viewport = slim header bar (~143px) plus the full-bleed dark-violet photographic hero (~964px, ~1.07 viewport heights): candid collaborative-office photograph under a violet/dark wash, overlaid 60px Figtree capitalize headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.', short supporting copy on technical SEO/content strategy/focused execution, primary violet pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' and secondary link-style CTA 'Explore Our Services'. Text occupies a left-weighted column with text-safe negative space guaranteed by the darkening overlay; next region (light about split) may just peek on tall viewports.

homepageRegions.purpose: Header bar with logo, centered inline navigation and violet pill consultation CTA; collapses to compact mobile menu.
Full-bleed dark-violet photographic hero with display headline, supporting copy and primary/secondary CTAs about getting found in search.
About/positioning split: masked portrait photo (analyst/consultant at work) left, dense multi-bullet copy on RankForge's approach and principles right.
Trust strip: centered heading and row of ~5 desaturated placeholder marks (generic wordmarks/sectors served, never fabricated client logos or reference marks); reduces to wrapped set on mobile.

Very tall asymmetric services collection for the six SEO services: 4-across icon-card row, 2-across wide cards, remaining cards in a final row; white rounded cards with icon chips and violet pill 'Learn more' actions.

Two sequential narrative splits presenting RankForge's process (01 Diagnose, 02 Prioritise, 03 Execute, 04 Improve) and approach: medium photo with floating qualitative stage chips, one image right-aligned, one left-aligned.
Light FAQ band: small flat illustration/subject montage left, violet pill accordion stack right answering common SEO questions (no invented stats); first item expanded.

Photo-backed card band: full-bleed workplace photograph darkened, white rounded cards plus one dark accent card carrying RankForge's positioning statement and service focus (adapted from testimonial composition; no invented testimonials, ratings or metrics).
Compact newsletter/lead band with inline fields wired to the WAZIBIZ Form Service.

Closing conversion anchor: near-black full-width contact banner with closing CTA 'Ready to make organic search work harder for your business?' and 'Talk to RankForge', followed by dense dark multi-column footer with navigation, contact email and service links.

imageSystem.photographyGrammar: Environmental business-context photography, not product display: candid to lightly-posed scenes of 1–2 people collaborating at laptops/desk in clean, restrained office environments; warm-neutral to slightly warm grade, moderate contrast, soft natural daylight, no cinematic drama, no desaturated fashion treatment, no macro product shots. Composition leaves text-safe negative space wherever copy or cards overlay imagery; hero and backdrop photos are darkened by violet/dark washes to guarantee contrast. Portrait about shot is a medium shot inside a soft lavender blob/circle mask. Illustration chips are flat, colorful, small-square montage elements for FAQ and service icons. Avoid: reference subjects/branding, stock handshake poses, sterile studio backdrops, hyper-saturation, centered symmetry where asymmetry is specified.

imageRoles.purpose: Full-bleed candid collaborative-office scene for the dark-violet hero background; wide landscape, subject off-center left/right leaving text-safe darkened zone; CRITICAL for first-viewport identity.
Portrait-orientation medium shot of a single SEO consultant/analyst at a device, displayed in a soft lavender circular/blob mask on a light surface.
Small square flat icon/illustration chips (~56–90px) for the six service cards and FAQ montage; consistent flat colorful style.
Two medium shots of single professionals with laptops/tablets against clean light/lavender backgrounds for the process narrative splits, hosting floating stage chips.
Full-bleed real-office photograph (wide, density-rich) darkened behind the proof card band with overlaid white/dark cards.

motionGrammar: Adaptation Contract: reference heavy scroll-linked parallax is replaced by scroll-triggered reveal transitions and reduced-motion-safe depth cues; macro composition and section rhythm stay static.
Focal motion: floating stage chips in the narrative splits get the most pronounced reveal (slight upward drift + fade, 600ms, staggered) as the substitute parallax focal element.
Supporting motion: sections and cards reveal on scroll with gentle fade/translate-up (~400–600ms, 20–30px travel, small stagger within card rows).
Button/link motion: violet pills shift fill color and shadow on hover/focus (150–250ms); chevrons rotate on accordion expand (~250ms).
Accordion rows expand/collapse with height transition; first item defaults expanded.
No structural motion: no horizontal scroll, no section reordering, no parallax on hero/backdrop photos.
prefers-reduced-motion: remove translations and reveals; show content immediately, preserve color/state feedback and focus visibility.
responsiveContract: Breakpoints: desktop 1440 design / ~1200 container, intermediate ~768–1024, mobile 375; viewport meta width=device-width, initial-scale=1.
All 10 canonical regions are retained on mobile — no content removal; sections reflow to single-column stacking.
Card collection: 4-across → 2-across (intermediate) → single-column stacked cards, each keeping its icon chip and pill CTA.
Splits (about, narrative x2, FAQ): image stacks above/below copy; the masked portrait scales down within its blob mask.
Header compresses; centered nav strip collapses to a menu button while the pill CTA stays reachable.
Full-bleed photo regions (hero, proof band) preserve overlay composition by cropping imagery with object-fit: cover and recentering focal points; headline and cards stack.
Logo strip reduces to a wrapped or horizontally scrollable smaller set.
Newsletter inline fields stack vertically on mobile; no horizontal overflow at any breakpoint.
innerPageVocabulary: EDITORIAL_SPLIT — image-with-mask one side, copy other side; used for About intro (reuse about-split-portrait language).
NARROW_NARRATIVE — centered narrow text column with pill badge heading; used for About principles narrative.
CARD_COLLECTION_4_2 — the services grid pattern reused for any listable content (About principles, Service detail links).
PROCESS_SEQUENCE — numbered 01–04 stage list with chips, echoing the narrative-split chip language.
QUIET_CTA — light band with badge + H2 + violet pill CTA, pre-footer conversion moment on inner pages.
CONTACT_SPLIT — form column (Name, Company, Email, Phone, Website, help-with select, Message) beside contact context, on light surface; form posts to the WAZIBIZ Form Service.
FAQ_ACCORDION — violet pill accordion reused for service-specific FAQs.
antiFallbackRules: Do not shrink the services collection into a single uniform 3-across grid; preserve the 4-across / 2-across asymmetric row rhythm.
Do not replace the dark-violet photographic hero with a plain colored or split-text hero.
Do not flatten the masked portrait blob into a plain rounded rectangle.
Do not convert violet pill buttons into square or outlined buttons; pills with trailing icons are systemic.
Do not center every heading; preserve left-aligned hero and split copy alignment as observed.
Do not add glassmorphism, gradients (beyond the hero wash) or heavy shadows absent from the reference.
Do not remove the black contact banner + dense dark footer in favor of a generic light footer.
Do not invent testimonials, star ratings or numeric metrics to fill the proof band or floating chips; use qualitative/positional content per Business Facts constraints.
Do not drop sections on mobile; stacking, not removal.
accessibilityAdaptations: Maintain WCAG AA contrast: white text over hero photo enforced by the dark violet wash; dark text on light surfaces and white cards.
Visible focus rings on all pills, links, accordion headers and form fields (violet focus token on light, light ring on dark).
Accordion implemented as accessible disclosure buttons with aria-expanded; no hover-only essential behavior.
Form fields labeled, required indicators and inline validation; help-with select is a real select element.
prefers-reduced-motion removes reveals/drift while preserving content and state feedback.
Mobile type remains >=16px body; tap targets >=44px for pills and nav.
Desaturated logo-strip marks carry accessible names or are treated as decorative per content truth.
declaredLimitations: Adaptation Contract v1: heavy scroll-linked parallax replaced by reveal transitions and reduced-motion-safe depth cues; hero/backdrop parallax drift is intentionally omitted.
Exact reference motion timing/easing unverified (LOW confidence); implemented with conservative 250ms/600ms approximations.

Client constraints prohibit testimonials, metrics, client names, team info and quantitative claims: the proof band reuses the testimonial composition with positioning/service cards, logo strip uses generic desaturated marks, and floating chips carry process stage labels instead of statistics.
No client logo/brand asset supplied; header logo is text-based wordmark treatment until provided.
Exact reference fonts (Figtree/Montserrat/Poppins) loaded via Google Fonts with system fallbacks; metrics may vary ±5% by platform.
Reference analysis extraction confidence is MEDIUM for some typography/UI roles; implementation preserves measured relationships (sizes, ratios) as primary evidence over unverified fine detail.
